column1: # rubric.tsv — the sections of the buildtel warrant set, one per test module, in document order.

column2: The Execution Records: Pages Fold Into One Tally That States How Much of the Response It Covers
The Test Targets: Ranked Longest First, a Built Target Listed but Not Ranked, and a Total That States How Much of the Paged Response It Covers
The Run-Time Table: Invocation Ids Read From a Gate Log, One Row per Test Target, and Each Row Carrying Whether Its Invocation's Listing Was Complete
The Build Log: Chunks Folded Into One Log in Order, the Failure Reports Picked Out of the Noise, and a Log Not Read Is Never an Empty One
The Log Request: One Chunk Asked For and Decoded, and Any Answer That Is Not a Chunk Refused Rather Than Read as an Empty Log
The Build Pulse: A Windowed Action Rate, and Every Terminal State Named Instead of Silent
The Findings Push: A Hook Log's Failure Vocabulary Reaches the Sink, Tagged, and Nothing Else Does
The Coordinator Sample: One Flushed Line per Interval Until the Process Is Gone
The Image Digest: What the Directory Answered, Else a Stable Absent
The Invalidation Probe: The Marker Lands, the Count Is Read From Bazel, and Nothing Is Stranded
The Target Rows Sent: The Per-Target Run-Time Rows Go to the Log Store Through the Shared Emitter, One Call per Bazel Invocation, and a Missing Emitter or a Refused Call Is Said and Loses Nothing
The Bazel Profile Split: An Invocation's Timing Profile Is Read From BuildBuddy and Summed by Category in Thread Microseconds, and an Invocation With No Profile Is Exit 3 and Never an Empty Table
The Cache Bytes: Each Bazel Output Base and the Disk Cache Is One Row Read From Where Bazel Writes, Sized by Blocks, Named by Its Own Workspace and Called Dead Only When That Workspace Is Gone
The Timeout Drop: An Explicit Timeout Is Removed Only From a Grid Whose Slowest Shard Fits Half the Size Default, All or None, and a Dry Run Writes Nothing
The Shard Plan:A Grid Whose Slowest Shard Took Over Half Its Size Default Gets a Planned Count, Never Planned Against a Raised Timeout, and a Dry Run Writes Nothing
The Child Process: A Real Child's Status and Output Become Exactly What the Callers Read

The Expunge: Only a Bazel Output Base Whose Workspace Is Gone and Whose Server Is Not Running Is Removed, Largest Exclusive Bytes First, Dry by Default, Read-Only Trees Included, and Never a Path Outside the Output Root
